plugins.locationAlwaysAndWhenInUsePermission: Slipstream uses your location continuously to record trip routes, detect speed camera zones, and time drag-race runs. Your location data is stored privately on your account.
plugins.locationWhenInUsePermission: Slipstream uses your location to show your position on the map and record trip routes.
plugins.locationAlwaysPermission: Slipstream uses your location in the background to continue recording trips and send radar alerts while the app is minimised.

infoPlist.NSLocationAlwaysAndWhenInUseUsageDescrip: Slipstream records your trip route and detects radar zones. Location runs in the background so recording continues when the screen is off.
infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUsePermission: Slipstream uses your location to display your map position and record trips.
infoPlist.NSLocationAlwaysUsageDescription: Slipstream records your trip route in the background so you don't have to keep the screen on while driving.
